title: Coverage reports unspecced modules in a stable sorted order
description: coverage reports unspecced modules in a stable sorted order
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement changes: coverage already reports unspecced modules; this only makes their order reproducible, as find_spec_files and the uncovered-file list already are
acceptance_criteria: compute_coverage_checked returns unspecced_modules sorted, so coverage text and JSON, PR comments and generate's spec order are identical across runs of the same command on the same tree, whatever HashMap order config.modules and manifest.modules iterate in

answers.constraints: the module set is unchanged; only its order is fixed
